name: GLODAPv2 (Global Ocean Data Analysis Project Version 2)

resolution: Point profiles and 1° x 1° on 33 standard depth levels

scales.note: GLODAPv2 bottle cruise compilation and 1x1 degree 33-depth-level climatology based on observations from 1972 to 2023
